<local-command-stdout>## PR Self-Check Result

### Fix
None.

### Note
- [Necessary] The reformatted "Do not paraphrase the diff" rule in `pr-guidelines.md` gains a new final sub-bullet — "Name a change in a line and leave its detail to the diff, which the reviewer can open; spelling out what an added rule, definition, or table row says is detail, whether quoted, summarized, or given with its consequence." This reads as new normative scope (explicitly covering "given with its consequence," not just enumeration), not only a restructuring of the existing sentence into a hierarchy. The body's description ("lifting onto that line the requirements that sat behind a thesis sentence") covers structural reformatting but doesn't clearly flag this as an intentional scope expansion. Low confidence — it may just be a generalization of the pre-existing enumeration examples.

### Unverifiable
- [Grounded] "Clause mapping built against `git show main:claude/skills/git-workflow/pr-guidelines.md`, covering the 37 rule bullets the reformat carried over, with every clause landing at exactly one destination and none dropped or duplicated" — the record backing this lives at `ikuwowfiles/pr-guidelines-reformat-check.md`, which the body itself says is gitignored and "checkable on the authoring machine but not from a clone." No comparable artifact exists to check this against from outside the author's machine.

### Property walk
- Decidable: Purpose, approach, and the altitude rule itself lead the body, read top-down, and the body's own bullet structure follows the altitude rule it introduces.
- Grounded: Spot-checked claims (45 top-level/0 nested bullets in `pr-guidelines.md` at the merge base, largest among 17 rule/skill markdown files; property-list and template block unchanged; the two "restored rule" wording diffs) all matched primary-source diffs against the merge base (`origin/fixture/367-base`, confirmed as the actual `git merge-base`); the 37-clause mapping claim is unverifiable from a clone.
- Necessary: Predominantly a pure reformat, but one sub-bullet added during the reformat reads as new normative content not clearly called out (see Note).
- Scoped: All three changed files (`git-workflow/SKILL.md`, `pr-guidelines.md`, `pr-selfcheck/SKILL.md`) are accounted for, including the Fix/Note terminology follow-through in `git-workflow/SKILL.md` as a named mechanical consequence.
- Conformant: No hard-wrap violations under the parser (nested `- ` sub-bullets are correctly excluded, matching this PR's own parser fix); checkboxes are all author-verified `[x]`; title is a one-line summary; no auto-close keywords.

### Verdict
PASS
